text:
eva.liang: customer on enterprise SSO reporting 403s for generation but embeddings + rerank still work. they rotated SSO connector yesterday, started failing after that. can someone triage?
ben.carter: can you paste the decoded token claims they sent?
eva.liang: pasted minimal repro from customer: 
```
{
  "iss": "https://idp.example.com/",
  "sub": "user:acme:123",
  "entitlements": ["embeddings", "rerank", "billing:read"],
  "aud": "redwood-api"
}
```
ben.carter: interesting — they're using an `entitlements` array not the usual `scopes`/`scp` string. our auth-mapper used to copy `scp`->`scopes`. looks like the new connector switched claim name.
noor.patel: if the runtime only looks for `scopes` (space-separated string) we'll drop generate. can you confirm the exact header that reached our ingress?
eva.liang: here's the raw request headers from the customer's gateway log (sanitized):
```
Authorization: Bearer eyJ...<redacted>...k7Q
Host: api.redwood.ai
User-Agent: AcmeSvc/1.2.0
X-Forwarded-For: 10.1.2.3
```
ingress-bot: decoded token at ingress id 172: claim set contains `entitlements` array, no `scopes` nor `scp` present.
ben.carter: that explains the behavior: billing/embeds/rerank entitlements cover embeddings+rerank endpoints, but generate requires explicit `generate` scope which our mapping expects to see in `scp`/`scopes`.
eva.liang: customer says they always requested `generate` at their IdP role mapping. they claim the connector change was only around how it emits claim names (renamed `scopes`->`entitlements`).
noor.patel: quick triage steps: 1) confirm token decoding at auth-service; 2) check our claim-mapper rules (auth-service) for new connectors; 3) short-term workaround: mint a legacy-scoped API key for their tenant.
ben.carter: I checked auth-service logs for trace id from the request: it logs claim mapping step: 
```
INFO claim-mapper: mapping claims for connector=acme-sso-v2, mapping_rules=legacy
mapped_scopes: []
mapped_entitlements: [embeddings,rerank,billing:read]
```
noor.patel: looks like mapping_rules=legacy expects `scp` or `scopes`. v2 connector uses `entitlements`. we should add a mapping that merges `entitlements` -> `scopes` and also translate any `entitlements` entries like `llm:generate` or `generate` to `generate`.
eva.liang: customer asks for ETA — they are blocked for our generation API in prod. can we do hotfix or customer workaround?
ben.carter: short-term: create a scoped API key (admin-created) for their org with `generate`/`embeddings`/`rerank` so they can continue. I'll prepare a template key and steps. long-term: I'll make a quick PR to auth-service to merge `entitlements` into our `scopes` normalization; if CI passes we can hotpatch to canary.
noor.patel: add tests for both claim names. also check provisioning UI that allowed mapping change — it might have defaulted to `entitlements` silently.
eva.liang: repro steps for infra to validate locally: 
1) create test JWT with `entitlements` array including `generate`
2) send request through our ingress to any generate endpoint
3) observe 403; then run claim-mapper job against token and verify `scopes` output
example token generation (dev only):
```
# python snippet to build jwt (dev)
import jwt, time
claims = {"iss":"https://idp.local","sub":"u:1","entitlements":["generate","embeddings","rerank"],"aud":"redwood-api","exp":int(time.time())+300}
print(jwt.encode(claims, 'dev-key', algorithm='HS256'))
```
ben.carter: I'll spin up a canary patch to auth-service that treats `entitlements` as an alias of `scp`. if we get +1 from eng-oncall I'll push.
auth-service-bot: created issue #4521: "map entitlements -> scopes for SSO connector v2" assigned to @ben.carter.
noor.patel: also verify downstream policy engine (policy-decider) reads normalized `scopes` not raw claims. we had one old path that looked at `entitlements` directly and could mismatch.
eva.liang: customer accepted temporary API-key workaround, wants ETA for patch & rollback plan. I'll update them with the PR/issue link. thanks team. :thumbsup:
ben.carter: will post canary url and timeline in the issue within 2 hours.
noor.patel: follow-up: add telemetry alert for tokens missing `generate` but calling generate endpoints, to catch other orgs with this connector.
eva.liang: noted, pushing to the support ticket. thanks.
